data.title: 塑心 · 琴旁的花
data.description: 她把花枝剪短一点，插进琴旁的花瓶。调整好位置后，她坐下来继续练习。
data.promptProse: Virtuosa stands beside her upright cello in a quiet conservatory room, gently arranging deep purple blooms and fresh foliage into a fluted crystal vase. Garden scissors and snipped stems lie on the mahogany side table, while filtered sunlight through sheer linen curtains warms the parquet floor.
data.animaCaption: Adjusting a slender flower stem in the crystal vase beside her cello, she takes a quiet breath of floral scent before resuming her afternoon practice.
